name: Kilnova
tagline: The operating layer for the invisible restaurant empire.
positioning: Kilnova turns dark kitchens into a single programmable network — one platform to launch, route, and scale delivery-only brands at continental scale.

hero.sub: Kilnova unifies your dark kitchens, virtual brands, and delivery marketplaces into a single command layer — so an enterprise can spin up a new concept in a new city before lunch service ends.

features.title: Brand Launcher
features.description: Deploy a delivery-only concept across dozens of kitchens in one workflow — menus, pricing, packaging specs, and marketplace listings sync in minutes, not months.

features.title: Order Router
features.description: Route every ticket to the optimal kitchen node by geography, capacity, and prep time. When one location floods, Kilnova reroutes before the customer notices.

features.title: Yield Console
features.description: See item-level margin across every brand and location in real time. Kilnova flags the SKUs quietly bleeding you and the ones ready to scale.

features.title: Capacity Grid
features.description: A live map of station load across your entire network, so operations can rebalance staff and equipment before the Friday surge hits the fryers.

features.title: Marketplace Sync
features.description: One source of truth pushed to every aggregator. Kill an 86'd item everywhere at once and end the era of phantom listings and refund storms.

features.title: Compliance Vault
features.description: Health scores, allergen matrices, and audit trails per kitchen node — enterprise-ready records that survive a surprise inspection and legal review.

testimonials.quote: We ran nine virtual brands across forty kitchens on spreadsheets and prayer. Kilnova collapsed all of it into one console — our regional launch time dropped from six weeks to four days.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

testimonials.quote: The Order Router alone paid for the contract. During a stadium event it rerouted 12,000 tickets across three kitchens without a single dropped ticket. My ops team actually took a break.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feldt

testimonials.quote: Kilnova's Yield Console showed us four concepts quietly losing money on packaging. We cut them, doubled down on two winners, and margin climbed eleven points in a quarter.
testimonials.name: Elena Vos

pricing.blurb: For operators consolidating their first cluster of dark kitchens.
For multi-city groups scaling brands across regions.
For enterprises running national delivery-only empires.

homepage.footerBlurb: Kilnova is the operating layer for the invisible restaurant. Build the empire nobody sees — from a single console.
